hints.title: Per-group Independence
hints.text: Each server group is completely independent from the others.

hints.title: Budget Equation
hints.text: Upgrading k servers leaves count[i] - k servers to sell, generating money[i] + (count[i] - k) * sell[i] cash.

hints.title: Closed Form Bound
hints.text: Condition k * upgrade[i] <= money[i] + (count[i] - k) * sell[i] yields k <= (money[i] + count[i] * sell[i]) // (upgrade[i] + sell[i]).

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Closed form integer division per group.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Binary searching each server group adds extra log factor when a constant time arithmetic formula exists.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space beyond the output array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Derive the linear inequality and bound the maximum upgrades cleanly.
